tasks.description: Create the Cargo workspace (crates rein-app bin, rein-release lib, rein-profiles lib), git init if absent, cargo-dist config for mac/linux/windows, and a GitHub Actions CI matrix building and testing all three targets, per .ai/blueprints/distribution.md §Components and §E-## Task Breakdown E-2. Acceptance: cargo test --workspace green on all three targets in CI.

Implement rein-release fetch + verify behind Http/Fs traits: SignatureVerifier trait with a Rejecting default backend (pending rein P-50), manifest schema check, per-file sha256 with unlisted/missing detection, tar path-traversal rejection, and a local fixture release server covering good tarball, bad signature, tampered file, missing manifest, unlisted file, traversal entry — fail closed on every bad input with nothing written outside staging, per .ai/blueprints/distribution.md §Components 1-2, §Security, §Test Plan. Tier 3: security_engineer review before commit.

Implement rein-profiles: enumerate Claude profiles (default config dir, ~/.claude-personal, every accounts.*.config_dir in $HOME/.rein/accounts.json), plan and apply a merge of ONLY the closed AllowedKey enum (hooks sourced from rein install output, enabledPlugins, extraKnownMarketplaces, attribution) into each settings.json via temp file + rename with a .rein-bak backup and --undo; property test proving every pre-existing key is preserved; wire `rein-app profiles list|apply`, per .ai/blueprints/distribution.md §Components 6, §Security trust boundary 3, §Test Plan. Tier 3: security_engineer review before commit.

Implement the LayoutWriter (unpack verified tarball into $HOME/.rein.staging-<ver>, check the stable layout bin/ hooks/ mcp/ shared/ scripts/ config/ secrets/ run/ VERSION, carry over operator-owned files accounts.json gate-override.json config/* secrets/* run/*, atomic rename with previous tree kept as .rein.prev-<ver> N=2, lock file) and the Runner that executes `rein install` then `rein doctor` from the installed tree with CLAUDECODE unset and output passed through verbatim; add the layout-equality test against install-rein.sh at the same tag, per .ai/blueprints/distribution.md §Components 3-5, §Security trust boundaries 2 and 4, §Test Plan. Tier 3: security_engineer review before commit.

Ship the Phase 1 distribution: Homebrew formula (tap), cargo-dist release workflow producing mac/linux binaries plus .deb/AppImage and a Windows installer; wire `rein-app update` (newest rein tag, release notes, confirm or --yes) and `rein-app rollback` (swap .rein.prev-*, re-run rein doctor) onto E-5; implement the Windows WslLauncher (wsl --status, install Ubuntu if absent, run Linux rein-app inside WSL, open Windows Terminal into the tmux session) behind a Shell trait with stubbed unit tests for no-WSL, no-distro, ready, per .ai/blueprints/distribution.md §Components 7-8, §API, §Rollback Plan, §Test Plan.
